hotels.title: Secluded Self-Contained Apartment Stay near Ballarat & Daylesford with Forest Views & Fireplace
hotels.description: Nestled in the heart of Victoria’s forested Goldfields region, The Sebel Creswick Forest Resort offers a tranquil escape surrounded by towering trees and serene walking trails. Take a short drive to explore the charming towns of Creswick and Ballarat, sample award-winning drops at local wineries including Meredith Wines and Eastern Peake Vineyard, or enjoy a soothing session at the renowned Hepburn Bathhouse & Spa. The resort’s peaceful setting invites relaxation, with nature at your doorstep and the fresh forest air setting the scene for a rejuvenating stay. Each apartment is designed for comfort and connection to the outdoors, featuring open-plan living spaces, a cosy fireplace and a balcony with sweeping views. After days exploring the region, unwind with a glass of local wine, soak in the lavish bathtub or curl up by the fire as evening settles over the treetops.

hotels.title: Charming Self-Contained Two-Bedroom Apartments near Daylesford & Hepburn Springs
hotels.description: Escape the hustle and bustle of the city, and reconnect with friends and family during a relaxing stay at The Sebel Creswick Forest Resort, a private retreat nestled between the charming city of Ballarat and the mineral waters of Hepburn Springs. Surrounded by acres of lush greenery, this peaceful resort is the perfect group getaway, with gourmet dining options and local attractions within easy reach. The neighbouring RACV Goldfields Resort welcomes guests to their bar and restaurant, serving the finest local produce and cocktails alongside golf-course views and occasional live music. Creswick is well-known for its walking and cycling trails, cosy pubs, quaint cafes and forested landscapes that you can spend hours exploring.
